summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Henry Slade, a Philadelphia spice house agent and old patron of the prize ring, was in the city, and that Tom Allen called him the most scientific sparrer in the world.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Dispatch, Saturday Evening, April 11, 1874'. Before 1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch.

notes: Allen appears only as the source of praise for Slade; no biography-level facts.
